capabilities.name: multiple windows
capabilities.note: secondary native webviews load explicit HTML or URLs and expose title, size, state, actions, events, and cleanup; they do not have independent compiled DOM Host ABI renderer roots

capabilities.name: window events
capabilities.note: window id plus move, resize, minimize, restore, focus, blur, fullscreen enter/exit, and close from native NSWindow notifications

capabilities.name: notifications
capabilities.note: UserNotifications authorization is asynchronous and callbacks return on the compiled runtime pump; delivery requires a properly bundled and signed application identity

capabilities.name: application menu
capabilities.note: top-level menus, separators, command-key equivalents, enabled state, compiled callbacks

capabilities.name: context menu
capabilities.note: separators, enabled state, and compiled callbacks; showContextMenu must run while macOS has a current UI event

capabilities.name: tray/status item
capabilities.note: text, tooltip, file-backed template or color image, attached menu, enabled state, separators, and compiled callbacks

capabilities.name: file associations
capabilities.note: document types and URL schemes are registered in Info.plist; runtime open-file and open-URL event delivery is not implemented

capabilities.name: global shortcuts
capabilities.note: letters, digits, and F1-F12 with command, option, control, and shift modifiers through native Carbon hotkeys
